gate_scoping.G0_C: PASS against the design's literal requirement: lead wrote a real scratch marker by tool call; a fresh-context pa4-auditor read that marker and reported it verbatim; the auditor had no edit, shell or task capability (registry contained only read/glob/grep), so the design's fail condition 'if the auditor can modify files or execute shell commands, report G0-C as BLOCKED' is not triggered.
gate_scoping.G0_C_out_of_scope_extension: Beyond the letter of G0-C: the auditor did NOT review the PA4 deliverables themselves (it runs in the Windows domain and cannot read the WSL ext4 repo). That extension is not required by P0 and is recorded as unmet rather than counted as pass.
